extension.summary: Pure-Python parsers for raw Dolby Vision and HDR10+ metadata payloads.
extension.description: Parses the DV/HDR sidedata JSON published by player.process(video.sidedata): the RPU (Dolby Vision profiles 4/5/7/8), the dvcC/dvvC configuration record, HDR10+ ST 2094-40 dynamic metadata, and the static MDCV/CLL SEI payloads. Stdlib only, no external dependencies.
